day_shape: 76 items: IDF strikes Beirut's Dahiyeh after Hezbollah rocket fire, CENTCOM reports US blockade has redirected 132 vessels and downed two Iranian drones in Hormuz, US lobbies IAEA board on 60% HEU resolution, student protests across 20 Iranian provinces.

threads.label: IDF strikes Beirut suburbs after rocket fire
threads.summary: The IDF struck Hezbollah targets in Beirut's Dahiyeh and issued evacuation warnings for Tyre after two rockets fired from Lebanon were intercepted over northern Israel. Lebanon's National News Agency reported two killed and 11 wounded; Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz said the strikes targeted Hezbollah command centres, and Defa Press claimed Hezbollah fired an air-to-air missile near Nabatieh.

threads.label: US Hormuz blockade and nuclear pressure
threads.summary: CENTCOM said USS Michael Murphy is enforcing a US blockade in the Arabian Sea that has redirected 132 commercial vessels and disabled six, and reported shooting down two Iranian one-way attack drones over the Strait of Hormuz. The US is lobbying IAEA Board of Governors members to back a draft resolution requiring Iran to account for 60% highly enriched uranium stocks.

threads.label: Iran-US diplomatic track via Pakistan
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bagheri told CNN Iran will respond with 'full force' to attacks and is seeking release of frozen assets and an end to sanctions, with Pakistan continuing as intermediary. Defa Press said Pakistani Interior Minister Naqavi delivered a special letter to Khamenei via Araghchi; Jerusalem Post reported Trump said Lebanon is not required in an interim Iran deal, and a Times of Israel source said the US is considering using Iranian funds for Gulf reconstruction.

threads.label: Gaza operations and Hamas figures
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt.-Gen. Eyal Zamir said during a Gaza visit that the military will not give up on fully disarming Hamas. The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing of Sakr Abu Karim, a Nukhba cell commander involved in the October 7 Kissufim attack, and Greek police arrested a suspected Hamas operative said to be planning an attack on an Israeli cruise ship.

threads.label: Student protests across Iranian provinces
threads.summary: Iran International reported student protests over university entrance exam rules continuing across at least 20 provinces on Sunday. Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post carried the same figure, citing reports of arrests and violence against demonstrators.

threads.label: Khamenei succession and regime messaging
threads.summary: Iran International reported that 100 days after Ali Khamenei was killed in an attack on his Tehran office, the Islamic Republic has yet to bury him or name a successor. Khamenei's office channel published remarks attributed to Ayatollah Seyyed Mujtaba Khamenei invoking Khomeini's legacy and a call for unity, alongside Defa Press claims of strategic defeat for the US 'hybrid war'.

threads.label: Iran World Cup logistics and visas
threads.summary: Iran's national football team landed in Mexico City under heavy security after a 13-hour flight, with coach Carlos Queiroz publicly complaining about late clarification of the squad's status. Jerusalem Post reported five Iranian players received US visas 10 days before the opening match while Iranian and African journalists were denied accreditation visas.
